basics.description: Deploy a pilot-sized Azure Virtual Desktop North Star environment. The Basics step selects the subscription, resource group and region. The template uses resource-group scope and uses a nested subscription-scope deployment for the autoscale role assignments that allow dynamic autoscaling to create hosts.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Choose the Azure region for the host pool, storage account, Key Vault, Log Analytics workspace and networking.

options.text: The deployment creates a pooled host pool using session host configuration, dynamic autoscaling, ephemeral OS disks, Microsoft Entra joined session hosts, Azure Files for FSLogix and App Attach, and Azure Monitor diagnostics. Learn more about Azure Virtual Desktop host pool management approaches.

basics.name: workloadPrefix
basics.label: Resource name prefix
basics.toolTip: Use a short, generic prefix. It is normalised for resource names where needed.

validations.message: Use 3 to 18 lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. Start and end with a letter or number.

options.text: The North Star uses Microsoft Entra joined session hosts, single sign-on with Microsoft Entra authentication, a host pool managed identity and least-privilege role assignments. Dynamic autoscaling creates hosts in this deployment, so subscription-scope autoscale roles must exist before hosts can appear. The host pool managed identity is new and safe to assign by default. The Azure Virtual Desktop service principal may already have the same roles in tenants that use autoscale.

elements.name: pilotUsersGroupObjectId
elements.label: Pilot users group object ID
elements.toolTip: Object ID of the Microsoft Entra group that receives Desktop Virtualization User and Azure Files share access.

validations.message: Enter a valid Microsoft Entra object ID GUID.

elements.name: localAdminUsername
elements.label: Session host local admin username
elements.toolTip: Stored as a Key Vault secret and referenced by the session host configuration. Do not use a personal account name.

validations.message: Use 3 to 20 characters, starting with a letter.

elements.name: localAdminPassword
elements.toolTip: Stored as a Key Vault secret. It is not written to any file.

constraints.validationMessage: Use at least 14 characters with upper-case, lower-case, number and symbol.

elements.name: assignAutoscaleRolesToHostPoolIdentity
elements.label: Assign subscription-scope autoscale roles to the host pool managed identity
elements.toolTip: Leave this on unless you will assign the roles manually before scaling runs. The managed identity is new for this deployment, so duplicate role assignments are not expected. The deploying user needs Owner or User Access Administrator on the subscription.

allowedValues.label: Yes - assign the roles now
No - I will manually assign the roles before scaling runs

elements.name: assignAutoscaleRolesToAvdServicePrincipal
elements.label: Assign subscription-scope autoscale roles to the Azure Virtual Desktop service principal
elements.defaultValue: No - leave existing service principal assignments alone
elements.toolTip: Default is No because many tenants that already use Autoscale already have these subscription-scope role assignments. Creating a duplicate assignment for the same principal, role and scope under a different name fails with RoleAssignmentExists. Turn this on only after checking the service principal is missing the roles.

allowedValues.label: No - leave existing service principal assignments alone
Yes - assign the roles if I know they are missing

options.text: If hosts are not created after deployment, check whether the Azure Virtual Desktop service principal has Desktop Virtualization Power On Off Contributor and Desktop Virtualization Virtual Machine Contributor at subscription scope. Find the service principal by application ID 9cdead84-a844-4324-93f2-b2e6bb768d07. If either role is missing, assign it at subscription scope with Owner or User Access Administrator.

Azure Virtual Desktop uses reverse connect, so the session host subnet does not need inbound internet allow rules. New subnets should have explicit outbound connectivity, so this wizard can create a NAT Gateway.

elements.name: networkMode
elements.label: Session host subnet
elements.toolTip: Create a new VNet for a standalone pilot, or provide an existing subnet resource ID when landing zone networking already exists.

allowedValues.label: Create a new virtual network
Use an existing subnet

elements.name: existingSubnetResourceId
elements.label: Existing subnet resource ID
elements.toolTip: Required only when using an existing subnet. The subnet must have outbound access and must support private endpoints if you enable the Azure Files private endpoint.

validations.message: Enter a valid subnet resource ID, or leave blank when creating a new VNet.
Provide a subnet resource ID when using an existing subnet.

elements.name: vnetAddressPrefix
elements.label: New VNet address prefix
elements.toolTip: CIDR range for the new pilot VNet.

validations.message: Enter a CIDR prefix such as 10.60.0.0/16.

elements.name: sessionHostSubnetPrefix
elements.label: New session host subnet prefix
elements.toolTip: CIDR range for the new session host subnet.

validations.message: Enter a CIDR prefix such as 10.60.1.0/24.

options.text: Session host configuration defines the image, VM size, ephemeral OS disk, Microsoft Entra join, Intune enrolment, Trusted launch, subnet and naming for disposable pooled session hosts.

elements.name: sessionHostVmSize
elements.label: VM size
elements.defaultValue: Standard D8ads v5 - 8 vCPU, 32 GiB memory, 300 GiB temp disk
elements.toolTip: Only sizes with a documented temp disk of at least 150 GiB are listed. The Windows 11 Enterprise multi-session image is 127 GiB, and Trusted launch reserves 1 GiB for VM guest state, so no-local-disk sizes such as Standard_D8s_v5 and Standard_D8as_v6 are excluded.

allowedValues.label: Standard D4ads v5 - 4 vCPU, 16 GiB memory, 150 GiB temp disk
Standard D8ads v5 - 8 vCPU, 32 GiB memory, 300 GiB temp disk
Standard D16ads v5 - 16 vCPU, 64 GiB memory, 600 GiB temp disk
Standard D4ds v5 - 4 vCPU, 16 GiB memory, 150 GiB temp disk
Standard D8ds v5 - 8 vCPU, 32 GiB memory, 300 GiB temp disk
Standard D16ds v5 - 16 vCPU, 64 GiB memory, 600 GiB temp disk
Standard E8ads v5 - 8 vCPU, 64 GiB memory, 300 GiB temp disk

elements.name: hostPoolDeploymentScope
elements.label: Host pool deployment scope
elements.toolTip: The hostPools template reference allows Geographical and Regional. Geographical is the standard default. Regional host pools are generally available but only in regions where regional host pool infrastructure is available.

allowedValues.label: Geographical - standard behaviour
Regional - only in supported regions

options.text: Regional host pools store metadata in the selected Azure region, but they are only available in supported regions. If the region does not support regional host pools, deployment fails with RegionalScopeNotAvailable. Use Geographical unless you have confirmed regional host pool availability for the selected region.

elements.name: sessionHostNamePrefix
elements.label: Session host name prefix
elements.toolTip: Maximum 11 characters. Azure Virtual Desktop appends a suffix to make the computer name.

validations.message: Use 1 to 11 characters, starting with a letter.

elements.name: maxSessionLimit
elements.label: Max session limit
elements.toolTip: Pilot starting point only. Autoscale capacity calculations use this value.

validations.message: Enter a whole number from 1 to 40.

elements.name: imageSku
elements.label: Windows 11 Enterprise multi-session image
elements.toolTip: Select the marketplace image family. Confirm the exact marketplace SKU in your tenant before production.

allowedValues.label: Windows 11 Enterprise 26H2
Windows 11 Enterprise + Microsoft 365 Apps 26H2

elements.name: marketplaceImageVersion
elements.label: Marketplace image version
elements.toolTip: Enter an exact image version. To find the newest version, run: az vm image list -l <region> -p MicrosoftWindowsDesktop -f <offer> -s <sku> --all --query "[-1].version" -o tsv. The offer is office-365 for the Microsoft 365 Apps image and Windows-11 for the image without Microsoft 365 Apps.

validations.message: Enter an exact version such as 26300.9457.260914. Do not use latest.

elements.name: enrollSessionHostsInIntune
elements.label: Enrol session hosts in Microsoft Intune
elements.defaultValue: Yes - enrol each new host (North Star)
elements.toolTip: The North Star manages session hosts with Intune. Enrolment needs Intune licences and automatic MDM enrolment configured in the tenant. If enrolment fails, session host provisioning fails with MdmJoinFailed after about 30 minutes. Choose No only for a lab without Intune.

allowedValues.label: Yes - enrol each new host (North Star)
No - Microsoft Entra join only, for a lab without Intune

elements.name: availabilityZones
elements.label: Availability zones
elements.toolTip: Comma-separated zones supported by the region and VM size. Use 1,2,3 for a zone-resilient pilot where supported.

validations.message: Use comma-separated zone numbers, for example 1,2,3 or 1.

options.text: The deployment creates a premium Azure Files storage account with separate shares for FSLogix profiles and App Attach packages. It enables Microsoft Entra Kerberos on the storage account, but tenant admin consent and NTFS permissions remain post-deployment steps.

elements.name: enableFilesPrivateEndpoint
elements.label: Azure Files private endpoint
elements.toolTip: Creates a private endpoint for the storage account file endpoint and links privatelink.file.core.windows.net to the VNet.

allowedValues.label: Yes
No

elements.name: azureVirtualDesktopServicePrincipalObjectId
elements.label: Azure Virtual Desktop service principal object ID
elements.toolTip: Recommended. Find the Enterprise application with application ID 9cdead84-a844-4324-93f2-b2e6bb768d07, then copy its object ID. When supplied, the template assigns the subscription-scope autoscale roles and storage Reader and Data Access role to it.

validations.message: Enter a valid object ID GUID, or leave blank.

options.text: If you do not assign subscription-scope autoscale roles to the new host pool managed identity, no hosts are expected to be created until an Owner or User Access Administrator manually assigns Desktop Virtualization Power On Off Contributor and Desktop Virtualization Virtual Machine Contributor at subscription scope. Learn's dynamic autoscaling article also names the Azure Virtual Desktop service principal, but many tenants already have that assignment. Check it before assigning to avoid RoleAssignmentExists.

elements.name: azureVirtualDesktopArmProviderServicePrincipalObjectId
elements.label: Azure Virtual Desktop ARM Provider service principal object ID
elements.toolTip: Optional. Assigns Reader and Data Access on the storage account for App Attach on Microsoft Entra joined hosts.

validations.message: Enter a valid object ID GUID, or leave blank.

options.text: Dynamic autoscaling for a session host configuration host pool can create and delete hosts. The weekday schedule keeps 100 percent of active hosts during each phase so ephemeral OS disk pools use create and delete rather than stop and deallocate.

elements.name: scalingTimeZone
elements.label: Scaling plan time zone
elements.toolTip: Windows time zone ID used by the scaling plan schedule.

validations.message: Enter a valid Windows time zone ID.

elements.name: rampUpMinimumHostPoolSize
elements.label: Ramp-up minimum host pool size
elements.toolTip: Minimum number of hosts during ramp-up and peak.

validations.message: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10.

elements.name: rampUpMaximumHostPoolSize
elements.label: Ramp-up maximum host pool size
elements.toolTip: Maximum number of hosts during ramp-up and peak.

validations.message: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.

elements.name: rampDownMinimumHostPoolSize
elements.label: Ramp-down minimum host pool size
elements.toolTip: Minimum number of hosts during ramp-down and off-peak.

validations.message: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10.

elements.name: rampDownMaximumHostPoolSize
elements.label: Ramp-down maximum host pool size
elements.toolTip: Maximum number of hosts during ramp-down and off-peak.

validations.message: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.

options.text: The template builds the Azure foundation. Complete the numbered post-deployment steps from the template outputs and README before allowing pilot users to sign in: tenant SSO settings, Conditional Access review, Intune FSLogix settings, Microsoft Entra Kerberos admin consent, profile share NTFS permissions, App Attach package upload and scaling role assignment if you did not create it here.
